notes.title: Sensei! I Like You So Much! January Major Update Preview
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=k-JSKeHRo6M;full][/previewyoutube]
Sensei, thank you for waiting!

[i]The long-awaited major update is finally here![/i]

[h2][b]Sensei! I Like You So Much!” 【0.10 Version Update】 Coming in January 2025!
[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]1. Brand new [Tamigotchi] Pet Game Machine![/b]
[/h3]
You can now raise your favorite characters in the pet machine! Feed, play, work, idle and enjoy several fun mini-games…  

Plus, it can float on your desktop to accompany! (Who wouldn’t want to relax during work in February?)


[h3][b]2. Fully customizable Fanzine + Online Convention Open![/b][/h3]

You can fully customize your own Fanzine and share it at the online convention!  

You can also visit other players' booths, collect their fan-made freebies, and admire the Fanzine they've carefully created!  
 (Is the cyber online convention really here?)

[h3][b]3. One-day Merch Store Manager[/b][/h3]

Manage a near-bankrupt vintage merch store! Become a "One-Day Manager" and organize the shelves!  
Will you revive the store or will it go out of business? The choice is in your hands!

[h3][b]4. Everything is Customizable [/b][/h3]

 Customize readers' IDs, the randomly refreshed comments under stories, and the daily trending topics – all can be freely defined!

Plus, enjoy more daily stories featuring your fellow fans and the grandmas; more mini-stories, stickers, mini-animations, and home deco!

All of these exciting updates will be available later this month! Stay tuned!


[b]Additionally, "Sensei! I Like You So Much!" is now available for limited-time demo experience on TapTap![/b]

[url=https://www.taptap.cn/poster/NFmQ7Kl4v2Tc?utm_content=aid796]Main event link here[/url]
